caption: LASSI box-shaped agency-communion state space
author: Ole Hätscher; Leon Pielage; Pascal Kockwelp; Simon M. Breil; Anna Junga; Jennifer Dabel; Benjamin Risse; Bernhard Marschall; Mitja D. Back

stateSpaces.caption: Discrete agency-communion box
stateSpaces.description: Box-shaped discrete interpersonal state space used to represent agent behavior along the two IPC dimensions agency and communion.

dimensions.caption: Agency
dimensions.description: Influence, control, or mastery, ranging from submissive or unassured to dominant or assured.

dimensions.caption: Communion
dimensions.description: Closeness, intimacy, affiliation, or warmth, ranging from hostile or cold to friendly or warm.

export.description: A momentary LASSI interpersonal behavior state represented by discrete agency and communion coordinates.
